opening.argument: The available material describes a named blockchain platform and invites viewers to make contact, but it does not set out a specific investment, recruitment, payment, credential, or other deceptive participation mechanism. The title calls Forsage a platform running on a decentralized system and blockchain, while the description asks viewers to send a direct message. A mention of payouts within minutes, without a stated mechanism for participation, does not establish that viewers are being drawn into a deceptive scheme. This supports treating the material as ordinary promotion, without certifying the platform's safety or legitimacy.

citations.quote: Forsage is a platform that runs on a 100% decentralized system and blockchain.
